research.notes: The agenda names a fund (Chiling Hammer Education Fund) administered via East Bay Community Foundation (EBCF, Oakland, EIN 94-6070996). Searches found no public page describing the Chiling Hammer Education Fund itself, and the EBCF About page does not mention it. The fund appears to be a fund held at EBCF rather than a separate registered organization, so no independent profile could be confirmed. EBCF is a possible pass-through grantor but was not profiled here because the agenda vendor is the fund, not EBCF.
